title: ZippoAppConfig
description: Schema for validating application deployment configuration (deploy/<env>/config.yaml)

NAME.description: Internal identifier for the container/service (e.g. backend, frontend, auth-service)

PORT.description: Port on which the application container listens

HEALTH.description: Fallback HTTP health check path (e.g. / or /api/v1/health)

SES.description: Whether the app task role requires ses:SendEmail and ses:SendRawEmail permissions

S3_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name to which the task role is granted PutObject/GetObject/DeleteObject access

SIDECARS.description: Optional sidecar container definitions running in the same task

ecr_image.description: ECR image repository:tag relative to caller account ECR (e.g. zippo-build:redis-alpine)

image.description: Public or full container image URI (e.g. redis:alpine)

health_check.description: HTTP health check endpoint path probed by the target group

priority.description: ALB listener rule priority. Must be unique across services sharing the ALB.

direct_port.description: Direct HTTPS port on the ALB forwarded exclusively to this service (e.g. 3000)

ENV_VARS.description: Environment variables populated from AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Parameter Store

name.description: Environment variable name exposed to the container (e.g. DATABASE_NAME, REDIS_HOST)

secure.description: True if stored as SecureString (encrypted with KMS), False for plain String

SECRETS.description: Sensitive credentials injected from AWS Secrets Manager

name.description: Name or ARN prefix of the secret in AWS Secrets Manager (e.g. JWT_SECRET, DB_URI)
